annotations.title: Counterparts of a national act in other countries

description: A national document's counterparts in the other live countries, through the EU acts it is linked to (via): by a link the national source records or by its notification to the Commission as a measure. Ranked: 1 = recorded by the national source; 2 = a notified measure LexAPI holds; 3 = a notified Cellar record LexAPI does not hold (no id). An EU act (CELEX sector 3) as id groups its measures the same way. Only live countries are returned (see lex_national_coverage). A notification is not a finding that the measure transposes the act. BUSINESS+ only; the national-law allowance does not apply. Output is bounded (limit per act, up to 25 acts, ~40,000 characters); more gives the next offset, and jurisdictions narrows the lookup. Cost: 20 credits per call or page.

id.description: National document id or EU act CELEX: a CELEX number, or a national document id, e.g. "AT-NOR-12345".

jurisdictions.description: Only these live countries, e.g. ["si","es"]; default every live one.

offset.description: Skip this many EU acts (value given in more).
